# Building Applications on Language Models

> Build a tested bilingual assistant service on any language model: typed outputs, tools, grounded answers, evaluation and safety checks. SDAIA Academy course AE-203, version 2027.2.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 20,468 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Calling models well](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/slides/day1.md): sessions: Tokens, context and cost, Three API shapes, one interface, Prompts as versioned code, Streaming, timeouts and retries; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/slides/day1.html; about 5,643 tokens
- [Day 2: Structured data and tools](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/slides/day2.md): sessions: Schemas for model output, Validation, retry and fallback, Tool calling, Workflow or agent; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/slides/day2.html; about 4,662 tokens
- [Day 3: Grounded answers](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/slides/day3.md): sessions: Chunking and indexing a policy corpus, Lexical, dense and hybrid search, Answers with citations, Saying the answer is not there; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/slides/day3.html; about 4,185 tokens
- [Day 4: Evaluate, protect and ship](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/slides/day4.md): sessions: A small evaluation set, One model grader, checked against labels, Input and output checks, Packaging the assistant as a service; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/slides/day4.html; about 4,480 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone project presentations](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/slides/capstone.md): page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/slides/capstone.html; about 944 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Tokens and cost for 10,000 messages](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/labs/D1_1_tokens_cost.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: One request, three shapes, one client](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/labs/D1_2_three_shapes.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Wasil's instructions as a versioned template](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/labs/D1_3_prompt_versions.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Timeouts, retries and a fallback model](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/labs/D1_4_retries.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Route, date and complaint type as a typed object](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/labs/D2_1_schemas.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Repair, cap and a human queue](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/labs/D2_2_repair_fallback.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: The trip-status service as a tool](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/labs/D2_3_tool_calling.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Workflow or tool loop](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/labs/D2_4_workflow_agent.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Two chunkings of the policy corpus](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/labs/D3_1_chunking.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Keyword, vector and hybrid search](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/labs/D3_2_search.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Answers with checked citations](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/labs/D3_3_citations.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: Saying the answer is not there](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/labs/D3_4_abstention.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: Forty golden cases](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/labs/D4_1_eval_set.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: A faithfulness grader against labels](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/labs/D4_2_grader.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: Masking and flagging](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/labs/D4_3_safety_checks.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: Wasil as a tested web service](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-203/labs/D4_4_service.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
